fullContentHtml:
UPSC Combined Medical Services CMS Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission, UPSC has released the Result for the Combined Medical Services (CMS) Examination 2026. This recruitment has been released for 1358 posts. The online application process for UPSC CMS were accepted from 11 March 2026 to 31 March 2026. The Examination was Conducted on 02 August 2026. Candidates must download their UPSC Combined Medical Services (CMS) Result 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 March 2026
  • Last Date : 31 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 24 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 05 August 2026
  • Result : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

UPSC Combined Medical Services CMS Result 2026 – Out is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 31 March 2026.

The official website is: https://upsc.gov.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
